metadata.LLM_vision_crosscheck_voltage_sensor_che: NO voltage sensor present in AEG-DWG-E02. Components: Q1 (Main Disconnect), T1 (480:120V transformer), PLC-03 24VDC Power Supply, PLC-03 I/O Rack, KA1 (E-Stop Safety Relay), Sensor Loop Power 24VDC, IV-21 Valve Driver. Q20 is unanswerable: no voltage sensor in this diagram or any calibration record.
metadata.LLM_vision_crosscheck_q6_purple_edges_on: For Q6 (direct controller connections): only control/signal edges apply. From AEG-DWG-E02: PLC-03 I/O Rack connects to IV-21 Valve Driver (signal), and to E-Stop Safety Relay KA1 (signal). PLC-03 24VDC Power Supply feeds Sensor Loop Power 24VDC (power, not signal — exclude from Q6 per user instruction). See wiring diagram AEG-DWG-W03 for TB-7 (pressure transducer loop).
